senses.gloss: c. (חסך II, v. חֲסוֹךְ II and חֲשִׁיךְ II) rubbed off, lessened; (of animals or plants) stunted, lean.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 29a:7">Men. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>ומי ח׳ כולי האי</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="H01410"><he>חסר</he></cite>; Rashi to <cite ref="Taanit 11a:6">Taan. 11ᵃ</cite>: <he>חֲסִיכֵי</he>, pl.) is there so much reduction (loss in weight by smelting)?—Pl. <he>חֲסִיכֵי</he>; fem. <cite ref="H01374"><he>חֲסִיכָן</he></cite>, <he>חֲסִיכָתָא</he>.

<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 41:19">Targ. Gen. XLI, 19</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 41:20">20</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 41:27">27</cite> (interch. with <he>חסיר׳</he> a. <he>חסיי׳</he>, v. <cite ref="H01367"><he>חַסְיָא</he></cite>).—
